title: Adobe Flash Player End of Life

passages.heading: Adobe Flash Player EOL General Information
passages.text: UPDATED: January 13, 2021 Since Adobe no longer supports Flash Player after December 31, 2020 and blocked Flash content from running in Flash Player beginning January 12, 2021, Adobe strongly recommends all users immediately uninstall Flash Player to help protect their systems. Some users may continue to see reminders from Adobe to uninstall Flash Player from their system. See below for more details on how to uninstall Flash Player.
